instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Independent film and TV production company developing and producing scripted drama series and feature documentaries for streaming platforms and broadcasters. Slate of 6 projects in various stages of development and production. Evaluating AI-assisted script coverage and audience sentiment prediction tools for greenlight decisions. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 2 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: AI-Enhanced Pre-Production Workflow Mapping
opportunities.rationale: Building on the current interest in AI scripting and audience sentiment, this opportunity formalizes process mapping by integrating these predictive tools into the initial greenlight decision phase. This directly addresses margin compression by reducing pre-production risk and optimizing resource allocation before physical production begins.

first_actions: Map current content development workflow (scripting to pitch) identifying all manual handoffs.
Pilot AI sentiment prediction tools against the existing library of scripts to quantify predictive value.
Integrate mandatory compliance checks (e.g., copyright clearance tracking, regulatory jurisdiction assessment) into the proposed workflow map.
resources_needed: Small budget for AI tool subscription (pilot phase)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in pre-production cycle time by 15% while maintaining quality.
milestones: Workflow map completion and stakeholder sign-off.
AI pilot results analyzed against historical project success rates.
Minimum Viable Product (MVP) of the enhanced workflow implemented on one small slate.

opportunities.title: Integrated Digital Supply Chain & Resource Planner (iDSR)
opportunities.rationale: Given persistent supply chain volatility and severe margin pressure, a radical overhaul is needed to link inventory data, resource availability (equipment/talent), financial projections, and production scheduling. This system shifts decision-making from reactive crisis management to proactive optimization, ensuring every project greenlight is financially and logistically viable.

first_actions: Conduct a full audit of all material inputs (inventory/suppliers) that require digitalization tracking.
Develop core financial models linking cost-of-goods sold (COGS) directly to project phase gates and resource utilization.
Establish cross-departmental data governance protocols to ensure accurate, real-time input across finance, production, and procurement.
resources_needed: Technology lead capacity for integration architecture design
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unforeseen project delays due to resource or material shortages by 25%.
milestones: Core data sources mapped and cleaned.
Initial financial simulation model validated against historical overruns.
Successful dry run of the planning cycle for a mock-up project slate.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal process mapping workshop focusing on the 5 most time-consuming non-technical handoffs (e.g., legal review, budget approval).
Finalize scope and vendor requirements for the Inventory Digitalization Project, defining clear data inputs needed from finance and procurement.
Interview a potential external systems integrator to assess feasibility and cost estimates for the iDSR model (Opp 2).

key_weaknesses: Extreme dependence on generalist developers whose capacity is perpetually diverted to urgent operational fixes.
Siloed data and processes, preventing a holistic view of cost drivers across the value chain (from scripting to distribution).
Lack of dedicated budget or executive ownership for proactive innovation, limiting investment scope to immediate bottlenecks.

improvements: Initiation of inventory digitalization project provides necessary structural process improvement.
Active evaluation and interest in AI tools shows a willingness to leverage technology for efficiency gains.
persistent_gaps: The core resource constraint (2 developers) remains the single greatest blocker to implementing complex solutions.
Process documentation is insufficient, leading to knowledge loss or reliance on tribal knowledge during crisis periods.
Systemic inability to model cost fluctuations across non-inventory resources (e.g., talent costs by project phase).
achieved_milestones: Inventory digitalization process defined and launched.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Progress was made on inventory digitalization, addressing supply chain gaps. However, critical operational resources and the fundamental lack of dedicated innovation structure remain severe constraints, preventing a major score jump.
